qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Deep OEM specification lock-in and harsh-environment qualification cycles make switching suppliers prohibitively risky for components that cost pennies but risk catastrophic system failure. Demonstrated pricing power through contractual metal pass-through clauses across the 2021-2024 inflationary spike, maintaining 16.6% median GAAP ROIC and >35% tangible ROIC. Primary erosion threats include automotive cyclical downturns, OEM pricing pressure, and potential consolidation among hyperscale AI buyers.
qualitative.note: World leader in harsh-environment electrical connectors and sensor solutions. Passes all 6 gates. Extreme switching costs from mission-critical OEM platform spec-in and deep co-engineering in automotive and industrial markets, now supercharged by hyperscale AI data center interconnects. Robust balance sheet with >40x interest coverage and near 100% FCF conversion. [5-10Y g: content volume 4.0% + price 0.5% + mix/reinvestment 0.5% - cyclical auto drag 0.5% + share repurchases 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 16.6% and tangible operating ROIC of 35.7% demonstrate durable pricing power and high customer switching costs. In FY2025 and FY2026, sales expanded to $17.3B and $19.9B with FCF exceeding $3.2B and $3.4B (~100% conversion of adjusted net income). Industrial Solutions and Digital Data Networks are benefiting from massive AI infrastructure demand (+70% order growth), while Transportation Solutions continues steady content outperformance across electrified and software-defined vehicles. Fortress balance sheet with net debt ~1.0x EBITDA, long-term debt to net income of 2.6x, and interest coverage >40x.
